question: The duration of bouts in each round of the International Boxing Association (AIBA Open Boxing) match for Elite and Youth Men's and Women's Competitions should be ________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**3 minutes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **duration** of each bout in an **International Boxing Association (AIBA)** match for **Elite and Youth Men's and Women's Competitions** is **3 minutes**.
 
• Each round consists of **three bouts** of 3 minutes each, with a 1-minute rest period between rounds.
 
• This duration is **standardized** across all competitions under the AIBA to ensure **uniformity** and **fair play**.
 
• The 3-minute duration is designed to test the **strength, stamina, and skill** of the boxers.
 
• This format helps in maintaining the **intensity** and **pace** of the match, making it more engaging for both the participants and the audience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Boxing Association (AIBA)**__

 
 
• AIBA is the **world governing body** for the sport of boxing.
 
• It is responsible for overseeing the conduct of **amateur boxing matches** and competitions globally.
 
• AIBA was founded in **1946** and has its headquarters in **Lausanne, Switzerland**.
 
• The organization aims to promote and develop boxing as a sport and ensure **fairness** and **integrity** in all its activities.
